historical_notes.birth_year_accounts: Britannica/EBSCO give 1714 or circa 1714; Gale gives 1715; ages remain approximate.
historical_notes.early_accounts: EBSCO’s 1733 narrative and Gale’s 1737 narrative remain separately attributed as uncertain accounts; conflicting details are not blended.
historical_notes.reconstruction: Collection tasks, village repairs, meetings, NPC dialogue, settlement population/layout, creek, bridge, well, stall, seats, animals and encounters are explicitly labeled in Burmese as gameplay reconstruction, not verified biography or census.
historical_notes.mission_progression: Eight sequential missions cover the approximate age-18-to-25 span, with EBSCO and Gale episodes kept separate.

validation.measurement_caveat: Godot headless and Chromium ANGLE SwiftShader cloud touch emulation only. Cloud timing is not handset FPS; complete resolution of the owner-reported phone stutter and screenshot issues remains unverified.

alternating_cloud_render_comparison.renderer: Chromium ANGLE SwiftShader cloud software rendering
alternating_cloud_render_comparison.caveat: Alternating cloud runs only; wall-clock intervals from engine timestamps, not clamped process delta; differences do not establish physical-phone FPS, latency or smoothness.

changes: Stockade posts: 114 visuals grouped into 12 wall/material MultiMesh batches, keeping all 120 post/rail collision bodies.
Rigid animals: 52 part meshes grouped into 30 exact-material batches, preserving every source triangle and root motion.
Preserve fitted sole clearance through idle/walking, swimming exit and respawn instead of overwriting it every locomotion tick.
One camera collision sweep per render frame instead of repeating a sweep along the same already-cleared, shorter ray.
Web-only VisibleOnScreenEnabler3D pauses off-screen ambient NPC rig processing; World patrol simulation continues.
Web skips wind transform updates for trees over 28 metres from the player.
Retain the owner-reference compact joystick: 144 CSS px touch target / 132.48 CSS px visible ring, with separate 56 CSS px right-side targets.
Fresh phone-r14 asset names avoid mixing the new PCK with an older cached release. Previous release entries and player save schema remain unchanged.
